description: This file defines the LeavePeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler class which implements the logic to determine if a user should be directed to define the leave period. It checks whether the leave period is already set via a leave configuration service, and if not, enables the related feature.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler
classes.description: A class that enables the leave period definition feature on the homepage if the leave period is not yet defined.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the leave period is not defined and thus the feature should be enabled for the user.
